I attempted to incorporate three context events from the article (upcoming June 23 earnings with expected 18.33% YoY EPS growth, Zacks Rank #2 Buy, and the recent 10.55% monthly decline), but all were rejected by Aion's leakage-safe ablation gate. The forecast therefore falls back to the history-only linear_trend model, which projects a continued gradual decline from ~266 to ~259 over the 26-step horizon. This is consistent with the dominant downtrend in the data. Support is degraded due to limited evaluation folds, but this is the best available forecast.
